name: u
meaning: texel x origin on the page. Tex_CornerUV base for the horizontal corners in MCard_DrawSlotIcons.

name: width
meaning: width in texels; every reader subtracts 1 (MCard_Init, MCard_DrawSlotIcons, AnimSprite/Sprite loaders)

name: v
meaning: texel y origin on the page

name: page
meaning: texture page, returned by TexAtlas_GetPage. 10-byte records in the table at DAV directory+0xa.
